intro: If you're heading to Pa Sak Jolasid Dam to catch the floating train or photograph the sunflower fields around Phatthana Nikhom, and you'd rather sleep nearby in a quiet setting than in town — Mourakot Resort is the name travellers to this area mention · A 25-room bungalow resort tucked into leafy gardens in Phatthana Nikhom, about 10 minutes' drive from the dam · Every room has a private balcony, a fridge and free minibar, plus free parking · It's not a luxury resort, but it's quiet and reasonably clean, with rates from about ฿700/night, rising with the season and room type.

body.html: The main draw of Mourakot Resort is its quiet, peaceful garden setting in Phatthana Nikhom, near Pa Sak Jolasid Dam · Most reviews agree it's calm with a pleasant atmosphere — good for anyone who wants to escape the bustle and unwind close to nature · It's not in central Lopburi or beside a main road, but it sits in the right zone for people set on visiting Pa Sak Dam, riding the floating train, or shooting the seasonal sunflower fields.

The resort is at 273/1 Moo 9 Soi 23, Phatthana Nikhom — about 10 minutes' drive from Pa Sak Jolasid Dam, near Wat Manao Wan and the sunflower fields that bloom from late in the year into early next year · A location like this suits travellers who drive themselves and plan to explore the Phatthana Nikhom area · If you want to head into Lopburi old town for Prang Sam Yot or the monkeys, allow a fair amount of driving time, since it's a separate zone.

There are 25 rooms, all bungalows, ranging from Standard Double and Standard Twin through Superior to Deluxe Bungalow · Every room has a private balcony, air conditioning, satellite TV, a fridge, free minibar and free Wi-Fi, with an en-suite bathroom and hot water · Many guests praise the clean rooms and friendly service, and note the stone table out front where you can sit with a coffee in the breeze · These are simple bungalows that lean on calm rather than design flourish.
"Quiet and peaceful, lovely atmosphere, clean rooms and good value. The staff are warm and friendly, and there's a little table out front to sip coffee in the breeze — great for a Pa Sak Dam trip."

To be straight with you, that 8.3 score comes from only a handful of reviews on the booking platforms · The number looks lovely, but the review base is still thin, so it's worth reading across a few channels before you commit · Some reviews also mention worn fittings in places, plus bedding and bathroom cleanliness that aren't always consistent room to room — fairly typical of a budget bungalow resort.

Another thing to know before you book: there's no pool, no on-site restaurant and no breakfast · Anyone expecting a full set of in-town hotel facilities may find the offering sparse · And because it's a rural zone, restaurants and convenience stores aren't right next door — plan to bring food or scout out spots in Phatthana Nikhom in advance · Staff speak limited English, so international guests may want a translation app handy.

Overall, Mourakot Resort scores around 8.3 out of 10 from a handful of real reviews, which is solid for a bungalow resort in the Phatthana Nikhom area · It isn't for travellers who want a full facility list or a central location, but judged on quiet, the garden atmosphere, a balcony in every room, free parking and rates from about ฿700 rising with the season — it's a sensible pick for anyone set on visiting Pa Sak Dam and wanting to sleep nearby in calm surroundings.

A tip from reading the reviews: book directly or check availability ahead, especially during sunflower season and long weekends, since there are only 25 rooms and dam visitors favour this zone · Check the room condition as soon as you arrive — if the bedding or bathroom isn't right in any room, you can ask to switch · And bring food or note down restaurants in Phatthana Nikhom first, because it's pretty quiet around the resort.
